summary.text: Hard-hearted Strife, daughter of Nyx and mother in turn of toil, famine, battles, lies, lawlessness and ruin.
Hyginus places Discord among the children of Night and Erebus together.

story.text: Night bore hard-hearted Eris without a father. Strife then continued the dark genealogy herself, bearing Toil, Forgetfulness, Famine, Griefs, Battles, Murders, Quarrels, Lies, Lawlessness, Ruin and Oath — the pains that turn discord into the texture of human life.
Hyginus makes Discordia a daughter of both Nox and Erebus, one member of their crowded brood of death, sleep, misery and fate.
